newsitem.title: USA: CBOT corn, soybeans limit-up on dry weather-trade.
newsitem.headline: CBOT corn, soybeans limit-up on dry weather-trade.

text.p: CBOT new crop corn and soybean futures rallied the daily trading limits in fast trade Monday in response to dry and hot Midwest weather, traders said.
"We didn't get any rain, and that means sharply higher prices," said one commission house trader.
Most of the rain that fell over the weekend missed central Illinois, which is a high crop production area that needs rain, traders said.
Wheat futures were also sharply higher, mostly on strength borrowed from corn and wheat.
At 0938 CDT, November soybeans were 25-1/4 cents per bushel higher at $6.19 per bushel, December corn was 11 cents per bushel higher at $2.48.
